maya: Heads-up — Conduit API is GA as of today! :tada: Public rollout starts now across hosted (us-west/us-east/eu). Docs + migration guide live: https://redwood.dev/docs/conduit-ga

maya: High level — Conduit unifies gen + tool-calling primitives and introduces a lightweight streaming handshake optimized for mobile and edge clients. Key models: conduit-7b, conduit-13b, conduit-13b-int8.

maya: New endpoints: POST https://hosted.redwood.ai/v1/conduit/generate (sync + streaming). Tool-calling is handled via the `tools` field in the request body (see examples).

jonah: Quick example curl for streaming (very small handshake):
```bash
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\\
  -d '{"model":"conduit-13b","input":"Write a short getting-started note","stream":true}' \\\
  https://hosted.redwood.ai/v1/conduit/generate
```

roman: Will we update the SDKs today or staged? I can cut a small mobile-focused release with the new streaming client if eng-devex wants it.

maya: Staged — web + node SDKs get stable v3.2 today; mobile (iOS/Android) lightweight client will be released in 24h. We pushed prebuilt libs to the SDK repo under `conduit-client`.

eli: Ops notes — we're rolling by org over 6 hours. Prewarming engaged for high-QPS orgs; dedicated pools unaffected. If you see unusual CPU/GPU pressure, ping #eng-runtime and I'll snapshot.

ops_oncall: Prewarm script ran at 12:05p PT in us-west; memory profiles look nominal. I'll escalate if any new OOMs crop up.

sarah: Security note — Conduit keeps the same data handling guarantees as hosted API (no training). If you have customers with extra compliance needs, use Private/Dedicated or enable data-retention flags in the console. We validated HMAC header changes for the streaming handshake.

jonah: Small implementation detail for runtime folks — we added `X-Stream-Mode: conduit-lite` header to short-circuit framing. Make sure gateways and proxies accept that header.

maya: Migration: legacy `/v1/generate-sync` endpoints will be supported for 90 days. Encourage teams to test Conduit using canary keys — DM me or @roman for access.

roman: I'll push a short quickstart gist and a one-button migration checklist in the docs channel.

deploy-bot: deploy: hosted/conduit/gateway v1.0.0 deployed by CI at 2026-03-23T19:34:12Z — canary 10% -> roll starting.

maya: Thanks everyone. Please flag regressions in #product-qa and open issues with `conduit-ga` tag. Short-term focus: latency telemetry and mobile SDK docs.

eli: :thumbsup:

roman: :rocket:
